description: List workers (taskees) in the organization. Supports filtering by name/email/phone substring, contact-info presence, and last-activity date. Each row includes completion_count (total task completions).

active_since.description: ISO date/datetime — only workers with last_active_at on/after this

has_phone.description: true = only workers with a phone on file; false = only without

include_inactive.description: true = also include inactive workers (e.g. tombstones left by a merge or delete) — useful for auditing right after tascan_merge_workers / tascan_delete_worker

query.description: Substring match on name, email, or phone

name: tascan_list_workers
